newsitem.title: USA: Marathon in Ecuador power buy.
newsitem.headline: Marathon in Ecuador power buy.

text.p: Marathon Power Tsachila Ltd, a unit of Marathon Oil Co's Marathon Power Co Ltd, has bought a 50 percent stake in Power Services Ecuador Ecuapower Compania Limitada (Ecuapower) for an undisclosed sum, the company said in a statement.
The assets comprise a 96 megawatt power plant at Santo Domingo, west of the capital and a 34 megawatt power plant at Santa Elena on the Pacific Coast.
"We announced that we were looking at opportunities in Latin America and the Pacific Rim, this is the first in Latin America for Marathon Power," said spokesman William Ryder.
Ryder said Marathan had no target for revenues from independent power generation projects overseas.
Both of the plants in Ecuador are diesel-fired, Ryder said.
"We have a lot of refineries and it seems logical to get into power generation," he said.
Marathon Oil is a subsidiary of USX Corp's USX-Marathon Group.
